summary.zh-CN: Chromium 浏览器，内置 EchoAgent 页面助手
summary.en: Chromium browser with an EchoAgent page assistant

description.zh-CN: 浏览器提供 Chromium 页面浏览、持久登录态、标签页与地址栏，并内置 EchoAgent 侧栏，让 agent 可以围绕当前页面进行整理、问答和辅助操作。
description.en: Browser provides Chromium browsing, persistent login state, tabs, and an address bar with an embedded EchoAgent sidebar for page-aware organization, Q&A, and assistance.
